title: Learning Graded Sparse Mechanisms: A Representation Theorem and Certified Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2610.16537v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In a variety of multi-agent and physical environments, an element's update depends strongly on a few other elements and weakly on many, and both the identity and the number of the elements that matter change with the state of the system. Such graded sparse mechanisms are common, for instance, in flocks, crowds, learned particle simulators and the neighborhood aggregation of graph networks, yet they have received little systematic study as a class of functions with the grading given. In this paper we study the supervised learning of the mechanism when the grading is provided by the environment, as a weight on every element. First, we define the class by axioms, where each element's influence is capped by its weight, the dependence on the weights is regular, and no element is distinguished, and prove a representation theorem: the class is exactly the Lipschitz ball of a transport metric on weighted multisets, and the metric is forced by

translated_title: 学习分级稀疏机制：一个表示定理与可认证的泛化
translated_abstract: 在多种多智能体和物理环境中，一个元素的更新强烈地依赖于少数其他元素，而微弱地依赖于许多其他元素，并且起作用元素的“身份”和“数量”都会随系统状态而变化。这种分级稀疏机制十分常见，例如存在于鸟群、人群、学习型粒子模拟器以及图网络的邻域聚合之中，然而作为一类“分级信息已被给定”的函数，它们却很少得到系统性的研究。本文研究的是当分级由环境以施加在每个元素上的权重的形式提供时，对该机制的有监督学习。首先，我们通过一组公理来定义这一函数类别：每个元素的影响力受其权重限制、对权重的依赖是正则的、且没有任何元素是特殊的；在此基础上我们证明了一个表示定理：该函数类别恰好是加权多重集上某个传输度量的Lipschitz球，且该度量是被唯一确定的。
tldr: 本文将“分级稀疏机制”公理化定义为一类函数，并证明了一个表示定理：该类函数恰好是加权多重集上某个传输度量的Lipschitz球，从而为这类机制的学习提供了可认证的泛化保证。
en_tdlr: This paper axiomatically defines graded sparse mechanisms and proves a representation theorem showing that this function class is exactly the Lipschitz ball of a transport metric on weighted multisets, yielding certified generalization guarantees for learning such mechanisms.
